**In one line**: OpenAI's official DALL·E GPT is reportedly set to shut down on August 30, and users are advised to download any images they want to keep before then.

### Key points
- According to inc.com, the official DALL·E GPT inside ChatGPT is reported to be retiring as of August 30.
- Once the tool is gone, access to images created within it may be harder, so the report urges users to save needed images in advance.
- Image generation is already built into ChatGPT's native multimodal features, so the standalone GPT appears to be part of a cleanup rather than a loss of capability.

### Why it matters
It's another case of a dedicated "GPT" tool being folded into core functionality. Users who built workflows around a specific GPT should back up outputs and confirm an alternative path before the shutdown.
